integrity: Algebraic argument covers every n>=3 and all distinct endpoints. Finite reproducibility checks n=3..10 are corroborative only. Self-review is not independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Applies to shortest vertex paths in antipodal quotient cubes, n>=3, under one-intermediate-vertex rerouting. No claim for added-antipodal-edge convention or general graphs; unindexed overlap possible. Fang 2007 comparison limited to abstract.
title: The parity threshold for geodesic rerouting in antipodal cube quotients
